package.description: A compact, resident music player for Windows with a taskbar mini-player, media library, playlists, queue, and internet radio.

en-US.description: A compact, resident music player for Windows with a taskbar mini-player, media library, playlists, queue, and internet radio.
en-US.longDescription: SimplPlayer is a compact music player for Windows. It features a floating taskbar mini-player, a media library, playlists and a playback queue, internet radio with search and favorites, an equalizer with a live spectrum, crossfade between tracks, and multiple interface languages.
en-US.name: SimplPlayer
